note: STAR FILES, for reel-star-file.html. Two modes. solo: one subject, N desks, the last one is the downfall desk. versus: two subjects, N rounds, the desk picks a side in each and the closer asks to be argued with. Readings come from the app's own celebrity life reading, which runs on a public birth date with no birth time (timeAccuracy: unknown, hour defaulted to noon). Every deck says so on the slate and in the caption. Character and chart only: never a claim about a real person's private life, health or conduct. Photos resolve out of photos/<slug>.jpg, which genphotos.py fills from Wikidata P18; a subject with no free photo renders the redacted plate instead and that is a supported state, not a broken one.
